NV-2027-SB2.title: Revises provisions relating to the Grants Management Advisory Committee. (BDR 18-148)

actions.text: Prefiled. Referred to Committee on Government Affairs. To printer.

NV-2027-SB2.description: AN ACT relating to grants; requiring a member of the Grants Management Advisory Committee to abstain from voting on matters related to an entity with which the member is affiliated; and providing other matters properly relating thereto.
NV-2027-SB2.descriptionSource: Official alternate title (state legislature, via Open States)
NV-2027-SB2.aiSummary: The bill would require a member of the Grants Management Advisory Committee to not vote on matters tied to an organization they are connected with. It would affect people who serve on that committee.

NV-2027-SB18.title: Revises provisions governing guardianships. (BDR 13-565)

actions.text: Prefiled. Referred to Committee on Judiciary. To printer.

NV-2027-SB18.description: AN ACT relating to guardianships; revising provisions regarding completion of an assessment of the needs of a proposed protected person; increasing the maximum value of the estate of a protected person for purposes of a summary administration; extending certain periods for filing inventories, accounts and winding up the affairs of guardianships; and providing other matters properly relating thereto.
NV-2027-SB18.descriptionSource: Official alternate title (state legislature, via Open States)
NV-2027-SB18.aiSummary: The bill would change some rules for guardianships. It would update how a proposed protected person's needs are assessed, raise the highest estate value allowed for a simpler case process, and give more time to file inventories, accounts, and wrap up a guardianship's affairs.

actions.text: Prefiled. Referred to Committee on Natural Resources. To printer.

NV-2027-SB11.description: AN ACT relating to water; revising provisions relating to the cancellation of a permit to appropriate water; and providing other matters properly relating thereto.
NV-2027-SB11.descriptionSource: Official alternate title (state legislature, via Open States)
NV-2027-SB11.aiSummary: The bill would change the rules for canceling a permit to use water. It affects people and groups that hold these water permits in Nevada.
